, the nation's leading builder of luxury homes, today announced the highly anticipated grand opening of the amenity center at

, a resort-style master-planned community in Charlotte, North Carolina. The community’s expansive amenities and luxury home designs are now available for tours at 2525 Griffith Lakes Parkway in Charlotte.

Griffith Lakes offers residents access to a stunning array of amenities designed to elevate their luxury living experience. The newly opened clubhouse features a great room, game room, fitness studio, workout room, BBQ patio, fire pit lounge, pool, spa, and playground. Outdoor amenities include pickleball courts, tennis courts, beautiful lake access with a kayak launch, walking and biking trails, and a dog park.

"Griffith Lakes is an exceptional place to live, combining natural beauty, modern architecture, and an outstanding array of amenities – all situated around beautiful Griffith Lake," said Ryan Switzer, Division President of Toll Brothers in Charlotte. "The opening of the Griffith Lakes amenity center is an exciting milestone that provides residents with an unparalleled resort lifestyle in this vibrant community."

Griffith Lakes features four distinct collections of new homes, including townhomes and single-family designs ranging from approximately 1,680 to 3,400+ square feet. Homes offer open floor plans, flexible living spaces, covered patios, and personalization options for home shoppers to create their dream home at the Toll Brothers Design Studio. Homes are priced from the upper $300,000s.

Griffith Lakes is ideally located just miles from Uptown Charlotte, offering easy access to the area’s premier shopping, dining, entertainment, and recreational opportunities. The community is also adjacent to planned future commercial and retail space, further enhancing its urban appeal.
For more information about Griffith Lakes and other Toll Brothers communities in North Carolina, call 866-232-1719 or visit TollBrothers.com/NC.

Toll Brothers, Inc., a Fortune 500 Company, is the nation's leading builder of luxury homes. The Company was founded in 1967 and became a public company in 1986 with common stock listed on the New York Stock Exchange under the symbol "TOL." Toll Brothers builds new homes and communities in over 60 markets across the United States, serving first-time, move-up, active-adult, and second-home buyers. The Company also operates its own architectural, engineering, mortgage, title, land development, smart home technology, landscape, and building components manufacturing businesses.

Toll Brothers was named the #1 Most Admired Home Builder in Fortune magazine's 2026 list of the World's Most Admired Companies®, the ninth year the Company has achieved this honor. Toll Brothers has also been named Builder of the Year by Builder magazine and is the first two-time recipient of Builder of the Year from Professional Builder magazine. For more information visit TollBrothers.com.
